title: Zephyrine and the Salt
author: Hazel Iversen
blurb: Ulyana Nystrom, a debt-bound temple scribe, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
